purpose: Week-1 pipeline validation prior to production sweeps

provenance.units: frequencies in GHz; all coherence times in microseconds (scqubits returns ns)

criteria.analytic limits: Koch et al., PRA 76, 042319 (2007), Eqs. (2.5), (2.11)-(2.12); anharmonicity evaluated at ng=1/2 per Koch's convention
criteria.published numbers: Koch Sec. V Eq. (5.9) worked example (T2 ~ 8 s at EJ=30, EC=0.35 GHz, A=1e-4); Manucharyan 2009 Figs. 3 and 4B at all three of their published parameter sets (main text 9.0/2.5/0.52; Table 1 junction 8.93/2.39/0.52; Table 1 extended 8.97/2.47/0.52); Nguyen 2019 Appendix A 2 second-order flux bound (Tphi > 10 ms for all nine devices at A_flux = 1.8e-6)

known_limitations: 1/f dephasing formulas are first order in df01/dlambda and therefore return unphysically large Tphi AT a sweet spot; sweet-spot Tphi values must not be quoted as predictions (see Section 6 and 9.4c).
t1_* methods return the total (excitation + relaxation) rate at the scqubits default temperature, not the downward rate alone.

The superinductance is modelled as ideal, so qubit-array-mode hybridisation is absent. Section 9.2(iii) shows this is what makes the bare model miss f03 at Phi_ext=0 in Manucharyan's device (their array mode at 10.78 GHz couples to the 0-3 transition with g/|detuning| = 1.5-3.7). The effect on f01 AT THE FLUX SWEET SPOT is not bounded by this study and would require the array mode structure of the device being modelled; a naive dispersive estimate is the same size as the transition frequency itself and is therefore outside its own regime of validity.

Coherence values are model-based estimates under assumed noise amplitudes; vs Nguyen 2019 Table I the model is optimistic on absolute T1/T2 by a median 2.0x (T1) and 2.6x (T2), worst case 5.7x, measured device-by-device at the nine published devices' own parameters in 03_fluxonium_sweep.ipynb section 7. The wider 3-11x quoted in section 9.3 is a DIFFERENT comparison (our one nominal design against the range their nine devices span) and reflects the design-regime mismatch, not extra model error. Contributing causes: assumed Q_cap=1e6 flat vs measured tan(delta_C)=(2.0-3.6)e-6 at 6 GHz; assumed A_flux=1e-6 vs measured 1.8e-6.
